PROLOGUE.text: The coin laundry. Midnight. Somewhere, a sock is about to go missing...
*Dryer No. 7 starts spinning by itself. A sock is sucked toward the door!*
In my day, socks went missing the honest way. Behind the radiator! ...Oh, my back.
*The dryer window glows purple. A glamorous face appears in the glass...*
Greetings, single-leggers. We are QUEEN NYLONIA, ruler of the Hosiery and of the beautiful Island of Nylonia.
Why is she saying "we"? There is one of her.
We have TWO LEGS, darling. We are ALWAYS a "we".
Listen carefully, for We will only say this once. ...Twice if you are slow.
The DRYER DEMON has awoken. He steals your socks. He steals Our stockings. Soon there will be nothing left in any drawer, in any world.
*Everyone looks at Stinky Tabi. Stinky Tabi looks behind himself.*
We asked for a hero. Not a... *sniff* ...gym bag.
He took my other half, lady. I'm going.
Then we all go. The way of the sock is never to walk alone.
Very well. Choose who answers Our call. Bring snacks. Do NOT touch Our curtains.

PALACE_ARRIVAL.text: Welcome to Nylonia. Please wipe your... *looks at your foot* ...everything.
See that smoke over the sea? That is the TUMBLE THRONE, where the Demon sits.
To reach it, you must defeat his four generals. We shall send Our finest Hosiery with you.
I've got lots of holes, so I'm very breathable on long trips.
First, the LINT PLAINS. Go, Knight. And if anything touches Our curtains, We will KNOW.

PALACE_AFTER_CH1.text: We watched the whole thing through Our royal telescope. Magnificent. Mostly.
You did trip over a lint bunny.
Next: the STATIC SWAMP. Our royal engineers have FINALLY finished the bridge. It only took them three years.
Go when you are ready, Knight. And for goodness’ sake... have a WASH first.

PALACE_AFTER_CH2.text: We hear the Demon has been going about disguised as... a PRINCESS?
Princess Baby Bootie. With a tiara. And a spinning rattle.
A PRINCESS?! Without Our royal permission?! We have not even APPROVED that tiara!
...We also hear Cling Queen said something about Our sheen.
She said it was... last season. That part wasn't the hypnosis.
We are going to need a moment.
*The Queen stares out of the window for a very long, very dramatic moment.*
The BLEACH BADLANDS are next. Go, Knight. We shall be over here. Being TIMELESS.

PALACE_AFTER_CH3.text: The Bleach Baron, defeated! The fish of the Rinse Sea have their colours back.
One of them sent Us a thank-you note. It is VERY wet.
It's mostly just a drawing of a fish. Signed: 'a fish'.
Next: the IRONING FORTRESS, where the Iron Shogun flattens anything with a wrinkle.
...Knight. We have noticed you are EXTREMELY wrinkly. Do be careful.
I'm a sock! I'm SUPPOSED to be wrinkly!
That is exactly what a wrinkle would say.

PALACE_AFTER_CH4.text: Heartbreak? *quietly* ...We know a little about that.
*VERY loudly* ANYWAY! The Tumble Throne lies beneath the sea. This time, WE are coming with you.
We do not normally go places that are this... DAMP. But for Our people, We shall make an exception.
Your Majesty, that is just a crown with a shower cap on it.

PALACE_AFTER_CH5.text: *THE ROYAL LAUNDRY BALL. Socks and Hosiery dance together. The Demon is running the cloakroom.*
For saving both Our worlds, We name you... KNIGHT OF THE ROYAL DRAWER!
Welcome to the cloakroom. Lost socks are returned within one thousand years. ...We are working on that.
Love the ball, Nylonia. Shame about the sheen.
Lovely party! Everybody KNEEL! ...Sorry. The hypnosis wore off. The bossiness did not.
And no more disguises. I promise. *briefly turns into a coat rack* ...Old habits.
Now can somebody help me down from this chandelier? I don't know how I got up here either.

PALACE_AFTER_CH6.text: A MITTEN? Working a sock like a PUPPET? In Our kingdom?!
Gloves and mittens have always been jealous of socks. We get the feet. They get... handshakes.
Your Majesty, the Mitten Peaks are freezing. Might we borrow a scarf?
Absolutely not. Our scarves are for FASHION, not survival.
Go, Knight. Climb the peaks. And bring Us a souvenir. Something sparkly. And warm.

PALACE_AFTER_CH7.text: The mittens are reunited. The puppets are free. And the cloakroom has finally returned something.
Only one thing. But it is a START.
Knight, for saving Us AGAIN, We award you... the ORDER OF THE WARM TOES!
It is a hot water bottle. Do not argue with the Queen.
...Your Majesty, I think I hear something in the shoe cupboard.

CH1_INTRO.text: Ugh. It's like walking on a sweater that gave up.
The LINT PLAINS, Sir Knight! The Demon's Lint Gang guards the way to the Static Swamp.
HALT! You are entering the land of the... *ACHOO!* ...LINT GANG!
*Three tiny Lint Gang members tumble out of the sneeze.*
...Did you just sneeze out your whole GANG?
Every Lint Gang member is born from a sneeze. It's beautiful, actually.
Then watch me make MORE! *Ah... AH...*
*A MASSIVE sneeze-wind blasts across the plains! Everybody is covered in fluff. The Lint Gang runs for it!*
I'm FUZZY! There's lint in ALL my holes!
My gang... ran away. *sniff* ...FINE! I'll fight you MYSELF!
Go get him, Sir Knight! I'd help, but I'm mostly holes.

CH1_MID.text: HEY! You beat up my cousin!
You're related to the Lint Gang?
We're ALL related to the Lint Gang. It's a whole sneeze thing.
This is the weirdest family tree I have ever seen.
I may be tiny, but these ankles are FAST. Try to keep up!

CH1_BOSS.text: Nobody passes! The Demon made ME guardian of the plains!

CH1_END.text: The Demon said if I guarded the plains, he'd fix my holes. *a moth flies out of his mouth* ...He hasn't fixed my holes.
Why does he even want all these socks?
Nobody knows. He just keeps muttering... 'Not her. Not her. NOT HER.'
Spooky. Let's report back to the Queen!

CH2_INTRO.text: *Purple fog. Crackling sparks. Everything sticks to everything. A balloon floats past, covered in socks.*
My everything is standing on end.
The STATIC SWAMP, Sir Knight. Cling Queen rules here. Watch your fibres.
GREETINGS. I AM HERE ON A RESCUE MISSION.
THE RESCUE MISSION IS NOW FOR ME.
*{HERO} peels him off the tree. ZAP! All the static goes straight into his circuits.*
COMPRESSION LEVEL... OVERLOAD. TARGET ACQUIRED: YOU. *beep* ...SORRY IN ADVANCE.
He's static-scrambled! Knock the fuzz out of his circuits!

CH2_MID.text: REBOOT COMPLETE. COMPRESSION LEVEL: GRATEFUL. ALSO: EMBARRASSED.
Halt. Nobody crosses the swamp without passing ME.
Toe-Shinobi? Since when do you work for the Demon?
I don't. I've been standing in this static so long, I'm stuck to the path. Fighting is the only way I can move.
That's the saddest ninja story I've ever heard.
Then make it quick. And aim for the feet. I have five toes, so there is plenty of choice.

CH2_BOSS.text: So. NYLONIA sent a little errand sock. How sweet.
Sir Knight... why are her eyes doing that swirly thing?
Swirly? Darling, these are my FABULOUS eyes. I serve the Demon. I serve the Demon. I serve the... *twitch* ...the Demon.
She said that three times. That is NOT normal.
There's only room for ONE queen, sweetie. And she's wearing last season's sheen.
Okay. THAT part sounded exactly like her.
Now hold still, darling. The Demon wants you... STUCK!

CH2_END.text: *Cling Queen wobbles. Her swirly eyes spin... slower... and slower...*
*POP! The swirls fade from Cling Queen's eyes.*
*blinks* ...Why am I in a fight? Why is my lily crown on BACKWARDS?
You've been working for the Dryer Demon!
ME? WORK? Darling, I have never worked a day in my life.
The last thing I remember... it was a month ago...

CH2_FLASHBACK.text: *FLASHBACK. The Static Swamp, one month ago...*
Another day of being FABULOUS in a swamp. Alone. As usual. *sigh*
*A tiny figure in a tiara toddles out of the purple fog.*
PRINCESS BABY BOOTIE?! Oh, sweetie, come here! Who let a princess wander about a SWAMP?
Look at my pwetty spinning rattle, Auntie Cling...
Ooh, it IS pretty. It goes round... and round... and round...
*in a deep, smoky voice* You serve... the DEMON now.
I serve... the Demon. I serve the Demon. I serve the...
*Under the tiara: two little horns. In the air: a smell of burning lint.*

CH2_AFTER.text: Princess? Baby Bootie isn't a princess. He's a BABY. He doesn't even have a kingdom. He has a COT.
...Then it was never him. It was the Dryer Demon. In a TIARA. And I said "sweetie" to it.
And hypnotise, sweetie. He is turning the royals into his puppets. Then he marches on Nylonia and drags the whole kingdom to its DOOM.
Next stop, the Bleach Badlands. *looks you up and down* Your colours will FADE out there, sweetie.

CH3_INTRO.text: *THE BLEACH BADLANDS. A blinding white desert. Signs everywhere: "NO STAINS." "NO SPILLS." "NO FUN."*
Is it just me, or am I getting... beige?
Keep moving! Anything that stands still gets bleached. I stood still for ONE second once and lost a whole shade.
I used to be BLACK fishnet. ...Okay, I'm still black. But I FEEL lighter.
WAAAAAH! I was BLUE! I was SO BLUE! Now I'm... *sniff* ...EGGSHELL!
Hey, little buddy. Eggshell is very in this year.
Oh no. He's doing the floppy-arm thing. NOBODY survives the floppy-arm thing!

CH3_MID.text: *hiccup* ...I feel better now. I still look like a boiled egg, though.
Also, why does everyone keep calling me PRINCESS? And telling me to stop spinning my rattle at them? I don't even HAVE a rattle!
HALT! Nobody crosses this dune without bowing to the sumo master!
The Baron bleached me! Now I think I am a BEGINNER! A WHITE BELT! I must challenge EVERYONE!
Sumo has no belts! ...Wait. Does it? I DO NOT REMEMBER ANYTHING!
He just challenged a cactus. The cactus won.
BEHOLD! STRETCHY... *checks notes written on his own foot* ...BEGINNER SUMO!

CH3_BOSS.text: HALT, you STAINED creature! You are tracking COLOUR all over my lovely desert!
It's not a stain. It's CHARACTER.
He bleached half the Rinse Sea. The fish are see-through now. You can see what they had for lunch.
And they have never been more HYGIENIC.
Prepare to be WHITENED! BRIGHTENED! And slightly LEMON-SCENTED!

CH3_END.text: *Colour floods back across the desert like one big, happy rainbow!*
*sniff* I just wanted everything to be... clean. The Demon promised a world with no mess. No odd socks. No ketchup.
There's more to life than being spotless, Baron. Sometimes the stains are where the stories are.
...Did you get that from a fortune cookie?
I got it from a fortune cookie I found in my own heel. Don't ask.
Next stop: the Ironing Fortress. Pack a jumper. It gets STEAMY.

CH4_INTRO.text: *THE IRONING FORTRESS. A giant steaming castle shaped like an iron. Everything hisses. Somewhere, a kettle is screaming.*
Oh good, you're here. Took your time.
GRAN?! How did you even get here?!
There are no stairs to another dimension!
There are if you're old enough, dear. *CRACK* ...Ooh. That was my back. Or the stairs. Hard to tell.
Ma'am, with respect... how old ARE you?
Old enough to have knitted the very first sock. Young enough to kick your fishnets into next Tuesday.
HALT! SAFETY INSPECTION! NOBODY enters the Fortress without a HARD HAT!
Young man, I've survived ninety-five winters without a hard hat.
THEN YOU ARE NINETY-FIVE WINTERS OVERDUE! SAFETY FIRST! ...THEN FIGHTING!

CH4_MID.text: KNEEL! KNEEL before KING KNEE-SOCK, ruler of the sock drawer AND the top shelf!
His eyes are swirly too! He's been hypnotised, just like Cling Queen!
Young man, if I kneel, I'm not getting back up. You'll have to rule around me.
KNEEL... for the... DEMON... *twitch* ...and also for ME. Mostly the Demon.
We're socks. We don't HAVE knees.
EXACTLY! That is why I, with my MAGNIFICENT knees, am KING!
Knock the swirl out of him, dear. Gently. He was a lovely boy once.
GUARDS! ...Oh. I sent the guards out for snacks. ...Then I shall fight you MYSELF!

CH4_KING_WAKE.text: *King Knee-Sock wobbles. His swirly eyes spin... slower... and slower...*
*POP! The swirls fade from King Knee-Sock's eyes.*
*blinks* ...Why am I in a FORTRESS? And why is everybody glaring at me?
You were being a minion, dear.
A MINION?! I am a KING! The last thing I remember... it was two weeks ago...

CH4_FLASHBACK.text: *FLASHBACK. The Ironing Fortress, two weeks ago. The King is here to get his cape pressed.*
KNEEL! ...Nobody is here. I shall kneel to MYSELF. ...No. That is not how kneeling works.
*A tiny figure in a tiara toddles in through the steam.*
Uncle King! Uncle King! Goo goo!
PRINCESS BABY BOOTIE! My favourite little royal! Have you come to KNEEL?
No, Uncle King. Look at my pwetty spinning rattle...
A KING does not look at rattles. ...Oh. Ooh. It goes round... and round...
*in a deep, smoky voice* Now guard this fortress... and make everyone KNEEL for the DEMON.
Kneel... for... the Demon... *twitch* ...and also for me?
*Under the tiara: two little horns. Its tiny booties are smouldering.*

CH4_KING_AFTER.text: That was the Dryer Demon in disguise! He fooled Cling Queen the same way!
He made me shout KNEEL at everybody!
...Yes. But this time it was against my WILL.
Off you pop. The Shogun's waiting. I'll put the kettle on.

CH4_BOSS.text: I am IRON SHOGUN. I press. I flatten. I remove all WRINKLES.
Your wrinkles are... unacceptable. Prepare to be CRISP.
Young man, I have been wrinkly since before you were a CAST-IRON TODDLER.
...The grandmother. Even I fear... the grandmother.
Go on then, {HERO}. Iron him out. I'll hold your snacks.
That's why I'm holding them, dear.

CH4_END.text: *hisssss* You fight with honour. The Demon waits at the Tumble Throne, deep beneath the Rinse Sea.
But know this: he does not steal socks out of evil.
*a long, sad puff of steam* ...Out of heartbreak.
Heartbreak. Oh dear. That is the worst kind of wrinkle.
...Is anyone else crying? No? Just me? My holes are leaking.

CH5_INTRO.text: *THE TUMBLE THRONE. Deep beneath the Rinse Sea, a giant drum spins, scorching hot. A throne made of thousands of odd socks.*
Stay close, Knight. And do NOT touch anything. ESPECIALLY Us.
Look! That's the sock the Demon stole from the laundromat on day one!
...Wait. That's not him. That's somebody's GYM sock.
I've been tumbling in here for SIX MONTHS. I'm not a sock any more. I'm a LIFESTYLE.
The smell. The SMELL. Guards! ...Oh. We did not bring guards.
I'd help, but my holes let the smell straight in.

CH6_INTRO.text: *THE PUPPET THEATRE. Red velvet curtains. Creaky wooden boards. Every seat is filled... with puppets. They are all staring.*
Sir Knight, I don't like this. Puppets give me the shivers. And I'm mostly holes, so I shiver a LOT.
The Queen said socks have been going missing again. And this time they come back... with STRINGS.
*jerks upright* WELCOME! TO! THE! SHOW! *jerks sideways* ...Ow. Somebody is pulling my ankle.
Socklet?! There are strings tied to your arms!
I KNOW! I can't even scratch my own nose! I don't even HAVE a nose!
Cut the strings! ...Gently! ...Then fight him, I suppose. He looks like he wants to.
I DON'T want to! But my legs DO!

CH6_MID.text: *the strings snap* FREEDOM! ...I am going to go and lie down in a sock drawer for a week.
*drops from the rafters on strings* ...Do not look at me.
A ninja must be silent. Invisible. They put BELLS on my strings. Every time I move, they go JINGLE.
That is the least sneaky ninja I have ever seen.
Defeat me. Quickly. Before somebody asks me to do a little dance.

CH6_BOSS.text: *The spotlight swings to centre stage. Out struts a sock puppet in a paper crown, with yarn hair and enormous googly eyes.*
LADIES AND GENTLESOCKS! It is I! PRINCE PUPPETINI! Star of the stage! Darling of the drawer!
You're the one tying strings to everybody?
Every great show needs a CAST! And socks are SO easy to work. You just... slip a hand in.
...I said nothing. Forget the hand. THERE IS NO HAND.
On with the show! Tonight's performance: the TRAGIC DEFEAT of {HERO}!

CH6_END.text: *Something wriggles inside the puppet. Out pops... a small, grumpy, knitted MITTEN.*
Oi! Who turned the lights on?!
A MITTEN?! You were the hand inside the puppet all along!
Course I was! Socks get EVERYTHING! Songs! Drawers! Christmas stockings! What do mittens get? Left on a BUS!
Don't pity me! I'm the GRAND MITTEN! I'll make every sock my puppet! Catch me in the MITTEN PEAKS... if you can stand the COLD!
We're socks. Keeping feet warm is literally our whole job.

CH7_INTRO.text: *THE MITTEN PEAKS. Snow. Wind. Mountains of lost gloves and mittens, frozen solid. A ski lift creaks overhead.*
It's SO cold. My heel has gone numb. My toe has stopped talking to me.
I'm made of holes, Sir Knight. The wind goes straight THROUGH me. I can hear my own echo.
*bounces out of a snowdrift* SNOW BUNNY! I am the SNOW BUNNY now! Look how FLUFFY I am!
Lint Bunny?! What are you doing up here?
The Mitten said I could be king of the snow! Snow is basically sky-lint! *Ah... AH...* ACHOO!
*Two tiny Lint Gang members tumble out of the sneeze... and immediately start a snowball fight.*
FIGHT ME! Loser has to build a snowman! ...Winner ALSO has to build a snowman. I just really like snowmen.

CH7_MID.text: WARNING. TEMPERATURE: VERY LOW. JOINTS: FROZEN. DIGNITY: ALSO FROZEN.
I WAS SENT TO GUARD THE MOUNTAIN PATH. I HAVE STOOD HERE FOR THREE DAYS. A BIRD HAS BUILT A NEST ON MY HEAD.
Aww. It is a very nice nest.
THANK YOU. I HAVE NAMED IT KEVIN. ...BATTLE MODE: REQUIRED. PLEASE DEFROST ME WITH VIOLENCE.

CH7_BOSS.text: *At the summit, a gigantic knitted mitten towers over the snow. It has a pom-pom. It is very, very angry.*
YOU AGAIN! You ruined my puppet show! Now face me at full size!
You were TINY an hour ago!
Wool FLUFFS UP in the cold! This is my winter size! ...Also I have been doing push-ups.
For a THOUSAND YEARS, socks got all the love! Fluffy socks! Bed socks! LUCKY socks! Has anyone EVER said "lucky mitten"?!
EXACTLY! So every sock in the world will be my PUPPET! And the world will finally hold hands... with ME!
That's... kind of sweet. And REALLY creepy.

CH7_END.text: *deflates with a sad little squeak* ...Nobody ever goes looking for a lost mitten.
*A warm orange glow climbs the mountain. Somebody is huffing and puffing up the path.*
*panting* Excuse me... is there a GRAND MITTEN up here? I run the palace cloakroom now.
Somebody handed this in. It has been in Lost Property for... *checks the tag* ...a thousand years.
*He holds up a second mitten. Exactly the same pattern.*
Lost things are returned within a thousand years. I TOLD you we were working on it.
*The two mittens hug. The snow stops. Somewhere, a ski lift starts working again.*
...Is anyone else crying? My tears are freezing into little icicles.
Come on. Let's go home. And let's never, EVER put a hand inside a sock again.

CH5_MID.text: *Beneath the Tumble Throne: THE ODD SOCK VAULT. Mountains of lost socks. Something HUGE rises out of a pile... a giant made of a hundred different socks, all stitched together.*
HALT! I am MISMATCH! Guardian of the Tumble Throne! Made from every sock that ever went missing!
Is that a Christmas sock? And a baby sock? And somebody's football sock?
I am ALL of them! One hundred heels! ZERO pairs!
Wait... that stripy patch on your elbow. That's the sock I lost on laundry day!
Ooh, THIS one? It's YOURS? *waves it* It's my favourite patch! I wave it at night! Nyah-nyah!
FINDERS KEEPERS! ...Losers... sleepers? Weepers? I always mix that one up.
We do not have time to argue with a quilt. Knight, unpick him.
Nobody unpicks MISMATCH! The Demon stitched me himself! Prepare to be... MISMATCHED!

CH5_MID_END.text: *POP! POP! POP! Mismatch bursts at the seams! A hundred socks rain down, all hopping off to find their partners.*
My sock! ...Oh. It's a left one. I needed a right one.
Look on the bright side. Now you've got two lefts!
Onward. The Demon is just ahead. And somebody sweep up these socks.

CH5_BOSS.text: WHO DARES ENTER... THE TUMBLE THRONE?!
It's over, Demon! We know YOU were Princess Baby Bootie!
HAHAHAHA! Nobody says no to a baby in a tiara! I hypnotised CLING QUEEN! I hypnotised KING KNEE-SOCK!
With the royals as my puppets, I would march on Nylonia... and spin the whole kingdom into DOOM! ETERNAL TUMBLE DRY!
And Our stockings! Give them back this INSTANT, you overheated toaster!
I AM A DRYER! TOASTERS ARE COMPLETELY DIFFERENT!
{HERO}'s here now. And I want everybody's socks back!
...*long pause*... I am looking for someone.
Uh... are we sure we should fight the sad one?
I AM NOT SAD! I AM FURIOUS! AND ALSO A LITTLE BIT SAD! LOOK INTO MY SPIRAL AND FIGHT ME!

CH5_END.text: *The Demon's flames flicker down to a tiny, sad pilot light.*
A thousand years ago... I was just a sock. A plain black sock. I had a partner. Then, one laundry day... she was gone.
So you've been taking EVERY sock... looking for your pair?
Every. Single. One. And none of them are HER.
*A ghostly shimmer. THE LOST SOCK floats in.*
I fell down the back of the drawer.
*Silence. Then everybody cheers! The Throne of Odd Socks bursts into a shower of reunited pairs!*
*dabbing her eyes* This is the most beautiful thing We have ever seen. *gasp* ...Oh no.
We cried so hard... WE HAVE A RUN!

CH8_INTRO.text: *The shoe cupboard rattled all night. By morning, every sock in Nylonia had the same nightmare: being WORN... by a SHOE.*
Knight. We have news. The SHOES are on the march.
Shoes? But shoes are our friends! We live inside them!
Exactly. And how do YOU feel after a long day inside a shoe?
Now imagine how the SHOE feels.
Oh no. They want revenge for all the cheese.
Socks are vanishing at the SANDAL SHORE. Go. And wear sun cream.
*THE SANDAL SHORE. Sun. Sea. Sand in absolutely every crease.*
Sand in my holes. Sand in ALL my holes. I am basically an hourglass now.
MINE! MY BEACH! MY SANDCASTLE! MY OCEAN!
Baby Bootie? Why are you covered in white goo?
SUN CREAM! Somebody put on SO MUCH sun cream! I can't see! I'm a GHOST now! BOOOO!
*On a sun lounger, a flip-flop in sunglasses gives a thumbs up. "Get 'em, little dude!"*
Did that flip-flop just... give an order?
The cool floppy man said I can keep the WHOLE beach if I stomp you! WAAAH-TACK!
Careful, Sir Knight. A toddler on a sugar rush is the most dangerous creature on Earth.

CH8_MID.text: *Behind a sandcastle, something fluffy is building a SECOND sandcastle. It is shaped like a giant nose.*
It's me! SAND BUNNY! Lint plus sand equals... SANDPAPER! I'm SCRATCHY now!
I go where the fluff goes! And the fluff went to the BEACH! *Ah... AH...*
*A-CHOO! Two Lint Gang babies pop out, wearing tiny swimming goggles.*
MY GANG! They have learned to SWIM!
They're doing doggy paddle. On SAND.
The Flip-Flop said if I beat you, I get my own beach towel! Do you know how much lint a beach towel holds?!

CH8_BOSS.text: *Riding the biggest wave, on a surfboard made from a wooden spoon: a sock with a flip-flop strapped to his head.*
Duuuude! Welcome to the Sandal Shore, little socky bros!
Are YOU the one making socks disappear?
Disappear? Nah, bro. I'm FREEING them, man. Socks with SANDALS? Totally uncool.
He has a point. Socks with sandals IS a crime.
The Big Boot says the age of socks is OVER, dude. From now on: bare feet. Everywhere. Forever.
Oops. Was I not supposed to say that? ...Bummer. New plan: I wipe you out, and nobody knows I said it. COWABUNGA!

CH8_END.text: *face-down in the sand* Gnarly... totally gnarly wipeout...
Who is the Big Boot? Where are the missing socks?
Dude, I only met him once. HUGE. Steel toe. Smells like a wet dog in a cupboard.
He says shoes are tired of being sweated in. He wants to stomp every sock flat and make the world... BAREFOOT.
*gasps* A world without socks? Who would keep the toes WARM?!
The socks went in a big sack, bro. To the CATWALK. Some fancy fashion show.
*Meanwhile, in the darkest corner of the shoe cupboard... something HUGE taps its toe. Tap. Tap. TAP.*
*A deep voice rumbles: "One shoe down. Let the sock hero come. I have many, MANY more shoes."*
...Did anyone else just hear spooky narration?
Nope! Let's go to a fashion show!

PALACE_AFTER_CH8.text: A BIG BOOT? In Our shoe cupboard? We have been sharing a house with a VILLAIN?
I knew something was wrong with that cupboard. It always smells of feet. More than usual.
Dryer Demon, why are you wearing a sun hat?
I found it in Lost Property. It is very me.
Your Majesty, the missing socks went to the CATWALK!
A fashion show? Then you must go IN DISGUISE. Knight, wear... something. Anything. Please.

CH9_INTRO.text: *SOLE WEEK: the most glamorous fashion show in the shoe world. Cameras flash. Shoes sip tiny drinks.*
Our disguises are PERFECT. Nobody will ever know we are socks.
I am wearing a sock as a hat. You are wearing a sock as a scarf. We are MADE of socks.
Darling. DARLING. What are you WEARING?
Cling Queen! Did you come to save the socks too?
Save them? Sweetie, I came to WALK. Lady Stiletto asked ME to model. Finally, a stage worthy of my sheen!
You are modelling for the bad guys?
Darling, there are no bad guys in fashion. Only bad OUTFITS. ...Like that one.
If you want backstage, you'll have to get past me. And I NEVER let anyone go. I'm very clingy.

CH9_MID.text: *crackling* Fine. FINE. You win. But my hair looked AMAZING the whole time.
*At the judges' table sits a sneering sock, holding up a score card. It says: ZERO.*
Zero. Zero. Zero. And for the sock in the hat... minus four.
Bleach Baron? You are a JUDGE now?
The HARSHEST judge. Lady Stiletto pays me in stain remover. I have never been happier.
Your colours are too loud. Your stitching is too... stitched. I shall FADE you to a tasteful beige.

CH9_BOSS.text: *The lights go down. Music thumps. Down the runway struts a sock with a towering red high heel on her head.*
Darlings. DARLINGS. Hold your applause. ...Actually, no. Keep clapping. Louder.
Lady Stiletto! Give back the missing socks!
The socks? They're BACKSTAGE, sweetie. They're my new collection: 'SOCKS... AS PUPPETS'.
That has ALREADY been done! Chapter six!
Ugh. FINE. Then they shall be my new RUG. A sock rug. Very chic. Very crunchy.
You work for the Big Boot, don't you?
The Big Boot? Please. NO style. Steel toe? Mud? So last century. ...But he does pay well.
Now, darling. Let me show you how we walk the catwalk. ALL. OVER. YOU.

CH9_END.text: *wobbles on her heel* I... I have never fallen over before. Not once. Not even in a TORNADO.
*The audience gasps. Then they start clapping. The fall was SO dramatic that it is now a trend.*
Darling, that was a BOLD fall. Very avant-garde.
...It was? I MEANT to do that! The "Stiletto Stumble"! Next season EVERYONE will fall over!
*Backstage: dozens of socks, pegged to clothes rails. They cheer. One of them faints from happiness.*
Take them. But the Big Boot is moving his army to PUDDLE PARK. He wants every sock in Nylonia SOGGY.
Soggy socks?! The WORST feeling in the whole world!
*Meanwhile, in the cupboard, a huge boot reads a newspaper. The headline: STILETTO FALLS. He crumples it in fury.*

PALACE_AFTER_CH9.text: We saw it all on television. You were magnificent. Your hat was a disgrace. But you were magnificent.
I am staying at the palace for a while, darling. The fashion world is too cruel. And I lost a shoe. I do not even WEAR shoes.
Puddle Park. Wet. Cold. Squelchy. We shall stay here, by the fire, and support you emotionally.
I will dry you off when you get back. Free of charge. Mostly.
Take an umbrella, Sir Knight. Or two. I will hold one over each of your ends.

CH10_INTRO.text: *PUDDLE PARK. It has rained here for three hundred years. The ducks have given up and bought umbrellas.*
Every step goes SQUELCH. I'm not walking any more. I'm SQUELCHING.
Water goes straight through me. I am basically a sieve. A sad, damp sieve.
Lost Sock? What happened to you?
...I was looking for my pair in the pond... and a big yellow boot SPLASHED me... now I am a WET ghost...
...wet ghosts cannot float... we only DRIP... *drip*
We can dry you at the palace! The Demon has a dryer. He IS a dryer.
...the Boot said if I splash you... he will find my pair... I am sorry... BOOOO... *splosh*

CH10_MID.text: ...oooh... I feel lighter... is that... the sun?
*It is not the sun. It is Knee-Hi Kazuo, in a giant yellow raincoat, doing stretches in a puddle.*
HOO! HAH! Rain-sumo! The newest, wettest sport!
Kazuo! Are YOU working for the shoes too?
No! Galosh Grande hired me as his personal trainer! He pays me in puddles!
What do you even DO with puddles?
You STAND in them! For MUSCLES! ...I have not been dry in a week.
Now! Let's see if your stretch can beat my SPLASH!

CH10_BOSS.text: *The ground shakes. SQUEAK. SQUEAK. SQUEAK. A gigantic yellow rain boot stomps out of the biggest puddle.*
Nobody! It is still raining! It has ALWAYS been raining!
Oh. Good. Carry on then. ...NO WAIT. You're the SOCK HERO! The Big Boot wants you SOAKED!
Do you know my favourite thing, little sock? Jumping in puddles. Do you know my SECOND favourite thing?
WRONG! Wet socks inside boots! That cold, squishy feeling! SQUISH... SQUISH... *shivers happily*
Time for the biggest SPLASH of your life!

CH10_END.text: *Then... the rain stops. For the first time in three hundred years, the sun comes out over Puddle Park.*
...a rainbow... I have not seen one since I was in a washing machine...
Noooo! The puddles are DRYING! Now I will just be... a BOOT! An ordinary boot!
Ordinary boots keep feet dry. That is a GOOD job.
With nice, DRY socks inside them.
The Big Boot isn't just collecting socks. He's building something at the ROLLER DISCO. Something with LACES.
*Meanwhile: the Big Boot crosses out PUDDLE PARK on his map and writes ROLLER DISCO. Then he adds a smiley face. It is not a nice smiley face.*

PALACE_AFTER_CH10.text: *a pile of dripping socks spins inside him* WHIRRR... Next! WHIRRR... Next!
The Dryer Demon has dried forty-two socks, three ducks and one very surprised guard.
Your Majesty! A roller disco! We get to go to a DISCO!
This is a serious mission, Scout. ...But if there is a dance-off, you will WIN it. For Nylonia.
I cannot skate. I do not have feet. I AM a foot.
Then you shall roll, Knight. Roll with DIGNITY.

CH11_INTRO.text: *The ROLLER DISCO. A glitter ball spins. The music is so funky, the floor is wobbling.*
WHEEEEEEEE! Out of the way! I have WHEELS now! And I can't STOP!
I CAN'T! Rolla Disco gave me skates with no BRAKES! I've been going round in circles for TWO DAYS!
I grab chips every time I pass the snack bar! It is actually a really good system!
She said if I knock you over, she'll tell me where the brakes are! INCOMING!

CH11_MID.text: *rolls to a stop* ...Oh. You just put your heel down. I could have done that the WHOLE time.
*In the DJ booth, a robot sock wears giant headphones. A small bird on his head bops along.*
GREETINGS. I AM DJ MECHA-X. PLEASE ENJOY MY BEATS. BOOP. BOOP. BOOP.
Mecha-Sock! And... is that KEVIN? Kevin the bird?
KEVIN IS MY MANAGER NOW. KEVIN BOOKED THIS GIG. KEVIN TAKES TWENTY PERCENT.
...Does Kevin seem a bit suspicious to anyone else?
*Kevin stares at Fishnet Scout. Slowly. Without blinking. Then he whistles innocently.*
KEVIN SAYS: DROP THE BEAT. ALSO: DROP THE HERO. INITIATING DANCE BATTLE.

CH11_BOSS.text: *The doors burst open. Smoke. Lights. A sock with a glittering afro rolls in on a cloud of pure GROOVE.*
Heyyyy, sugar socks! Who is ready to BOOGIE?
Rolla Disco! The Big Boot is building something here. Something with laces. What is it?
Honey, the Big Boot has the WORST taste in music. He only listens to stomping. Stomp. Stomp. Stomp. For HOURS.
But he pays for the glitter. And THIS much glitter is not cheap, baby.
There is glitter in my holes. There will be glitter in my holes FOREVER.
Here's the deal, groovy: win a roller-dance-fight and I spill the beans. Lose, and you mop the rink. For eternity.
It's like a fight... but FUNKY! Let's ROLL, baby!

CH11_END.text: *spinning slowly to a stop* Whoa... you've got moves, sugar. Clumsy, sock-shaped moves. But MOVES.
A deal is a deal. The Big Boot is making THE GREAT LACE. A shoelace so long it can tie up the whole of Nylonia.
Like a big, sad present. He's been stretching it in my disco. That's why the floor's so wobbly.
*Everyone looks down. The rink floor is one gigantic coiled shoelace. It twitches.*
KEVIN HAS LEFT THE BUILDING. KEVIN TOOK THE CASH BOX. KEVIN... WAS NOT A GOOD MANAGER.
Before you go, honey: his next move is at the COIN LAUNDRY. He wants to SWAP every pair. Total chaos.
*Meanwhile: a small bird lands on a giant steel toe-cap. "Tweet," says Kevin. "Excellent," says the Big Boot.*

PALACE_AFTER_CH11.text: We have news. Kevin the bird has been spotted. He was wearing a tiny trench coat.
I KNEW it! I knew Kevin was up to something!
I AM HEARTBROKEN. ALSO I AM NOW A FREELANCE DJ. PLEASE BOOK ME.
The coin laundry, Knight. Where it all began. If the Boot swaps the pairs, no sock will ever match again.
Odd socks everywhere? That would be a nightmare.
*quietly* ...I was the ORIGINAL odd-sock nightmare, you know. This is just copying.

CH12_INTRO.text: *The COIN LAUNDRY. Midnight. Every machine is spinning. Every sock coming out is holding hands with the WRONG partner.*
We're back where it all started. Dryer No. 7...
Look! A football sock with a ballet sock! A Christmas sock with a SUMMER sock!
Argyle-san? Why are you... pink? With bunnies on?
The machines swapped my pattern with a toddler's bed sock. I am a samurai. Of the BUNNIES.
A shoe in a hood did this. He laughed and said "now NOTHING matches". Then he tripped over a basket.
Did you see where he went?
I will say nothing until my honour is restored. And honour needs a duel. ...Please do not laugh at the bunnies.

CH12_MID.text: *Out of a washing machine bursts Stinky Tabi. But he smells of... ROSES.*
Something is WRONG with me! I smell NICE! I smell like a GARDEN! Get it OFF!
The swap gave you somebody else's smell!
Some flowery sock got MY stink! Somewhere, a little flowery sock is going "PEE-YEW" at itself!
...To be fair, you do smell wonderful.
DON'T SAY THAT! Fight me! If I get sweaty enough, maybe my smell comes back!

CH12_BOSS.text: *The big dryer door swings open. Something huge climbs out, made of a hundred socks... again.*
HELLO AGAIN, LITTLE SOCK! It is I! MISMATCH! I am BACK!
But we unpicked you! All the socks found their partners!
They DID! Then the Big Boot swapped them all AGAIN! And I just... sort of... re-assembled. It happens.
Kevin said the Boot will make me KING of the odd socks! I've made a crown already! Out of a sock!
That crown is a sock. On your head. Upside down.
It is a SOCK CROWN! Socks are versatile! ...Now prepare to be RE-MISMATCHED!

CH12_END.text: *pop... pop... pop...* Here we go again...
*Socks burst out of Mismatch, hopping about and sniffing each other... until everyone finds their REAL partner.*
*sniff* ...THERE it is! My beautiful stink is back! Somebody hug me!
Hey... the Big Boot said if he cannot swap the pairs, he will steal the MUSIC. At the TALENT SHOW. Tonight!
At the theatre! His best dancer is the star act. Tap-tap-tap. He never STOPS tapping.
*Meanwhile, in the cupboard, the Big Boot practises his evil laugh. "MWAHAHA." Kevin holds up a score card: 6 out of 10.*

PALACE_AFTER_CH12.text: Every pair matched again. We are so proud We might cry. We will not cry. Royals do not cry. *dabs eye*
Your Majesty, can I have a medal?
You may have a CLOTHES PEG. Not for you. For OUR nose.
A talent show! Sir Knight, what is your talent?
Then you shall fight. In the talent show. On stage. With JAZZ HANDS.

CH13_INTRO.text: *The theatre again. But tonight it is SOCKS GOT TALENT. The whole audience is shoes. They are holding rotten tomatoes.*
LADIES AND GENTLESHOES! Welcome to the show! I am your host... PRINCE PUPPETINI!
A star never retires, darling! A star waits for a better offer! The Big Boot pays in APPLAUSE!
Can you really pay with applause?
NO! I am DREADFULLY poor! But SO happy! ...Our first act: a sock who thinks it can FIGHT!
The judges will score you on punching, kicking and STAGE PRESENCE. Mostly stage presence.

CH13_MID.text: *pinned under a curtain* The show... must... go on...
*Tap. Tap-tap. Tappity-tap. On stage, Stocking Gran is tap-dancing. With her walking stick. VERY fast.*
In my day, we tap-danced to SCHOOL! Uphill! Both ways! In the SNOW!
Sixty years champion, dearie! Mr. Tappington says if I win tonight, I get a NEW HIP! A shiny one!
I've got one now! It's a tennis ball! Now dance with me, young sock... DANCE OR DIE! ...Oh, my back.

CH13_BOSS.text: *A drum roll. A spotlight. A shiny black sock in a straw hat taps onto the stage. Every tap shoots out a musical note.*
Five, six, seven, EIGHT! Good EVENING, Nylonia!
Mr. Tappington! Why is the Big Boot stealing the music?
Stealing it, dear boy? He's SAVING it! For the big moment, when Nylonia gets TIED UP with a bow!
Tap. Tap. TAP! Do you hear it? That is the sound of DOOM. With a lovely little shuffle.
Thank you! I wrote it myself! It is called "Everybody Get Stomped". ...Now, shall we DANCE?

CH13_END.text: *taps... slower... and slower... tap... ...tap...* My tapping toes... they're TIRED!
*The audience of shoes goes silent. Then one tiny slipper in the back row starts clapping. Then EVERYONE claps.*
*grabs the trophy* I WON! Sixty-one years champion! Where is my tennis ball hip?!
Marvellous, all of you. Nobody has ever beaten me at tapping. Or fighting. Or both at the same time.
Listen, dear boy. The Big Boot hides his army in the BEDROOM. Under the bed. Where nobody ever looks.
UNDER THE BED?! That is where all the monsters live!
...And one very, VERY grumpy slipper. Whatever you do... do NOT wake the Dino-Slipper.
*Meanwhile, in the cupboard, the Big Boot taps his toe to "Everybody Get Stomped". He is secretly a big fan.*

PALACE_AFTER_CH13.text: Look at my trophy, Your Majesty! Look at it! LOOK AT IT!
We ARE looking at it, Gran. We have been looking at it for forty minutes.
The bedroom. Under the bed. Knight, take a torch. And a teddy. For emotional support.
I am not scared of the dark.
*whispering* He is a LITTLE bit scared of the dark.

CH14_INTRO.text: *THE BEDROOM OF DOOM. It is very dark. Something under the bed is snoring like a lawnmower.*
*whispering* Tiptoe. Tiptoe. We are SOCKS. Tiptoeing is what we were BORN for.
*whispering* Why is everything in here so BIG?
*whispering* Toe-Shinobi! What are you doing here?
*whispering* Guarding the bed. If anyone wakes the slipper, the slipper EATS them.
*whispering* So we have to fight you... QUIETLY?
*whispering* A silent battle. The ninja way. No yelling. No grunting. Not even one "hi-YAH".
*whispering* THAT IS THE LOUDEST WHISPER I HAVE EVER HEARD. Fight me.

CH14_MID.text: *whispering* ...You have learned the way of the quiet foot. Now go. Quietly.
*Something rustles in the toy box. A sock full of holes peeks out, wearing a teddy bear as armour.*
*whispering* Holey Moley, reporting for duty! I'm the Boot's bedroom guard! Mostly I just hide in here.
*whispering* Holey, you were on OUR side!
*whispering* I'm on the side with the most snacks! The Boot has LOADS of snacks. And a moth called Brian.
*A moth flies out of the toy box. It is Brian. Brian looks tired.*
*whispering* I have to fight you now. But softly, okay? I'm very breathable. I bruise easily.

CH14_BOSS.text: *Under the bed, something enormous and fluffy rolls over. Two sleepy eyes open. It is a dinosaur. A SLIPPER dinosaur.*
I am DOT. I have slept nine hours. I was SUPPOSED to sleep ten. Do you know what happens when I lose an hour of sleep?
The Big Boot promised me the comfiest pillow in the world if I guard his army. I have NEVER had a pillow. I sleep on DUST.
We can find you a pillow! The palace has LOADS of pillows!
TOO LATE! I am AWAKE now! And awake Dot is ANGRY Dot! *stomp*

CH14_END.text: *flops over* ...Okay... okay... that was a good tiring-out... now I am sleepy again...
Dot, what is the Big Boot hiding under here?
*yawning* ...his army... a hundred shoes... and a big map... with a red X... where he keeps the Queen's...
NO! DON'T FALL ASLEEP NOW! THE QUEEN'S WHAT?!
...Her CURTAINS?! The Big Boot wants the Queen's CURTAINS?!
*Meanwhile, at the palace, a small bird in a trench coat is quietly measuring the royal curtains.*

PALACE_AFTER_CH14.text: *clutching a curtain* NOBODY. TOUCHES. OUR. CURTAINS.
Your Majesty, why does the Big Boot want them?
...Because these are no ordinary curtains, Knight. They were woven from the very FIRST pair of socks. The Original Pair.
The Original Pair? Like... the first socks EVER?
Whoever holds the Original Pair holds every pair. Every sock in every drawer in every world would obey them.
...That is why I tried to steal them, long ago. Not my proudest moment. Fine. It was a LITTLE bit proud.
The SHOE CUPBOARD, Knight. Tonight. We go to the Boot before the Boot comes to Us.

CH15_INTRO.text: *THE SHOE CUPBOARD. Rows of shoes. Glowing eyes in the dark. It smells like a hundred gym bags having a party.*
We have not been in here since the Great Wellington Incident of last spring. We do not wish to talk about it.
Your Majesty, you came with us?!
Of course. A Queen leads from the front. ...From slightly behind the front. Behind the Knight, specifically.
HALT! Hard hat area! No socks allowed without a safety helmet!
Steel-Toe Sam! You work for the Boot?
I work for anyone who's building! And the Boot's building THE GREAT LACE! Biggest knot I've ever seen! Health and safety NIGHTMARE!
Sorry, kid. Rules are rules. No hard hat... means a HARD TIME.

CH15_MID.text: *sits on a toolbox* ...Okay. Fine. Tea break. I needed one anyway.
*On a shelf of shoeboxes stands a sock in a crown, shouting orders at a row of very confused trainers.*
LEFT! No, your OTHER left! Ugh! Shoes have NO sense of direction!
King Knee-Sock?! What are you doing in Our cupboard?
Ah! Cousin! The Big Boot made me General of the Trainers! Very important job! ...They do not listen to me AT ALL.
You promised to stay good after the hypnosis!
I AM good! I'm just ALSO a general! Can't a king have a hobby?! By royal decree... Trainers, ATTACK!
*The trainers all run off in different directions.*

CH15_BOSS.text: *Hissss... From the top shelf, something long and red slithers down. A shoelace. A shoelace with FANGS.*
Ssssso. The famous sssock hero. And... *tongue flicks* ...a QUEEN. How deliciousss.
We are NOT delicious. We are DELIGHTFUL. There is a difference.
I am the Ssshoelace Ssssnake, guardian of the Big Boot. I have tied up a hundred heroes. I will tie you in a BOW.
Exactly. You will be my present... to the BOSS. Ssso. Double knot, or triple knot?

CH15_END.text: *tied in a knot with himself* ...Hissss... I am... ssstuck...
Not so tough when YOU are the one tied up!
*Suddenly: STOMP. STOMP. STOMP. The whole cupboard shakes. A gigantic shadow falls over everyone.*
*A huge steel-toed boot reaches down... and SCOOPS UP the Queen!*
UNHAND US! Put Us down this INSTANT! You... you... SMELLY GALOSH!
*A deep voice booms: "I AM NOT A GALOSH. I AM THE BIG BOOT. And now... I have the QUEEN."*
*The shadow is gone. All that is left is one royal tiara... and a small feather. A KEVIN feather.*
...Scout. Get everyone. Every sock. Every friend. We're getting her back.

PALACE_AFTER_CH15.text: *The throne room. The throne is empty. The palace guards have taken off their helmets.*
This is all my fault. I should have held on to her. But I have so many holes... she slipped right through.
It is nobody's fault. Except the Boot. And possibly Kevin.
Darling, nobody kidnaps a queen and gets away with it. Trust me. I have TRIED.
Steel-Toe Sam says the Boot's whole army trains at the MUDDY PITCH.
*wipes a tear* ...Then we go to the Muddy Pitch. For the Queen. For Nylonia. For her curtains.

CH16_INTRO.text: *THE MUDDY PITCH. Floodlights. Mud up to your ankles. The scoreboard says SHOES 99, SOCKS 0.*
Ninety-nine nil?! We haven't even PLAYED yet!
The scoreboard is cheating! It is a SHOE scoreboard!
HOO! HAH! Welcome to training camp! I am the Boot army's new stretching coach!
Galosh recommended me! Stretch the hamstrings! Stretch the calves! Stretch the TRUTH!
Do you even know he kidnapped the QUEEN?
...He kidnapped the QUEEN? Nobody tells the stretching coach ANYTHING! ...But a contract is a contract. Let us stretch... YOUR FACE!

CH16_MID.text: *lying in the mud* ...I quit. I am going to stretch for the GOOD guys now.
*Steam hisses. Out of the fog marches a figure with a scorching-hot iron. He is pressing the grass flat.*
WRINKLES! WRINKLES EVERYWHERE! Even the GRASS is wrinkled!
The Boot promised me a pitch with no wrinkles. Perfectly flat. Perfectly pressed. A PARADISE.
But this MUD... it will not PRESS! I have ironed it for three days! It just goes SQUISH!
Then I shall iron YOU instead! At least YOU have creases!

CH16_BOSS.text: *A whistle blows. FWEEEEET! A muddy football boot jogs onto the pitch, doing keepy-uppies.*
Oi oi! The socks have turned up! Bit late, lads. We're ninety-nine up.
The Queen? In the Big Boot's private box, mate. Up at the SOLE SUMMIT. Best seats in the house.
Got her a cuppa and everything. She said the tea was too weak and threw it at a guard. Proper legend.
Here's the deal. Score one goal past me and I'll tell you how to get into the Summit. Lose, and YOU'RE the ball.

CH16_END.text: *flat on his back* ...GOOOOOAL. Ugh. Fair play, lads. Fair play.
*The scoreboard flickers: SHOES 99, SOCKS 1. The socks in the crowd go WILD.*
The Summit has one door. Only one sock can open it: the one wearing the GOLDEN SOCK of the old Sock Masters.
Where do we find a golden sock?
No idea, mate. Ask somebody old. Somebody wise. Somebody who smells of incense and sits on a mat.
*still ironing the mud* ...Almost got this bit flat... almost... SQUISH. ...NOOOO.
*Meanwhile, at the Sole Summit, the Queen sits in a cage made of shoelaces. She is redecorating it.*

PALACE_AFTER_CH16.text: *The throne is still empty. Someone has put a little sign on it: BACK SOON. — THE QUEEN (PROBABLY).*
The guards made the sign. It is very sweet. The spelling is terrible.
The Golden Sock... my master spoke of it. Only one who passes the Trial of the Dryer may wear it.
...Did somebody say DRYER? *cracks knuckles* I have waited SO long for somebody to say that.
Why does that make me nervous?

CH17_INTRO.text: *THE SAKURA DOJO. Petals fall. A wind chime rings. It is very peaceful. For about four seconds.*
Welcome, student. To earn the Golden Sock, you must pass three trials: Balance. Speed. And the Dryer.
You are not. Stand on one toe.
I only HAVE one toe. I am one big toe.
Then stand on HALF of it. ...Good. The Trial of Balance: fight me while I insult your posture.
Your posture is a wet noodle. Your stance is a sleepy worm. Your heel is... adequate.
ADEQUATE! That is the nicest thing he has ever said!

CH17_MID.text: *bowing* Balance... achieved. You wobbled twice. I counted.
*appears behind everyone* The Trial of Speed. Catch me if you can.
I have been here all along. Behind you. Behind HIM. Behind the sakura tree. Behind the OTHER sakura tree.
That is a lot of hiding.
It is a ninja's cardio. Five toes. Five seconds. Are you fast enough to save a queen?

CH17_BOSS.text: *The dojo doors fly open. Heat. Smoke. A spinning, roaring shape steps in, wearing a tiny white headband.*
Dryer Demon! YOU are the third trial?!
Who else? The Trial of the Dryer must be given by a DRYER! It is in the NAME!
I have trained a thousand years for this! I did push-ups! I did sit-ups! I did SPIN-ups!
NOBODY KNOWS! IT IS MY SECRET TECHNIQUE! ...Do not worry, little hero. I will only use... MEDIUM HEAT.

CH17_END.text: *panting, steaming* ...You passed. You are as warm and fluffy as a fresh towel.
*A golden glow shines from inside the Demon's drum. He reaches in... and pulls out a shining GOLDEN SOCK.*
It has been in my lint filter for a thousand years. I kept meaning to give it back.
Wear it with honour. And please wash it. It has been in a lint filter for a THOUSAND YEARS.
Now we can open the Summit door! Let's go!
Wait! If Kevin has been spying on us, he knows our whole plan. We have to find out who he REALLY is.
*appears again* I followed the bird. He nests on the MIDNIGHT ROOFTOP. And he is not alone.
*Meanwhile, on a moonlit rooftop, Kevin types on a tiny laptop. Behind him, something huge and metal whirrs to life.*

PALACE_AFTER_CH17.text: I gave away the Golden Sock. I feel... lighter. Is this what being nice feels like? It is horrible. I LOVE it.
The Midnight Rooftop. Kevin's lair. Sir Knight, I have a bad feeling about this.
I WILL COME TOO. KEVIN AND I HAVE UNFINISHED BUSINESS. ALSO HE OWES ME TWENTY PERCENT.
Darling, I was BORN ready. Then I spent three hours on my hair. So now I am FASHIONABLY ready.

CH18_INTRO.text: *THE MIDNIGHT ROOFTOP. The moon is huge. The city sleeps. On a chimney sits a nest... with a tiny satellite dish.*
HALT! Delivery boy for KEVIN ENTERPRISES! Nobody gets past without a signature!
Socklet? You work for KEVIN now?
He pays me in birdseed! I don't even LIKE birdseed! I deliver his spy photos! Tiny maps! A LOT of worms!
He said if you show up, I have to deliver... a PUNCH! Sign here, please!

CH18_MID.text: *A chill. The moonlight turns blue. A ghostly sock floats up from behind a chimney.*
...ooooOOOooo... I came to warn you... the bird... is not just a bird...
Lost Sock! What do you mean?
...Kevin was once a sock... a lonely sock, lost on a rooftop... the birds found him... and raised him as their own...
Kevin is a SOCK?! Kevin is a SOCK WHO THINKS HE IS A BIRD?!
...yes... and he blames all socks for leaving him behind... the Boot holds my pair... so I must fight you... BOO...

CH18_BOSS.text: *The chimney opens. A huge metal sock rises out of the smoke, its eyes glowing red. Kevin sits on its head, at the controls.*
GREETINGS. I AM MECHA-SOCK X... MARK TWO. KEVIN BUILT ME FROM SPARE PARTS AND SPITE.
Kevin! We know the truth! You were a lost sock!
*Kevin freezes. He puts down his tiny joystick. Then he picks it back up. Very angrily.*
KEVIN SAYS: NOBODY CAME LOOKING FOR HIM. NOBODY. NOT ONE SOCK. FOR SIX YEARS.
KEVIN SAYS: THE BOOT PROMISED A WORLD WITH NO SOCKS. SO NOBODY ELSE GETS LEFT BEHIND. ...ALSO: TWEET.
Then we will show him a sock never gives up on another sock. Even one who thinks he is a bird!

CH18_END.text: SYSTEM FAILURE. KEVIN, I AM SORRY. I WAS ONLY A MARK TWO.
*Kevin flutters down from the broken robot. Up close... yes. He's a tiny sock. With feathers glued on.*
Kevin... we came looking for you. Late. But we came.
*Kevin stares at the hero for a long time. Then he hops forward... and gives the tiniest, softest hug.*
*sobbing* I am NOT crying. My holes are just leaking.
*Kevin pulls out a tiny map of the SOLE SUMMIT, with a note: "He has a secret. Even HE does not know it."*
*Kevin shrugs. Then he says his first ever word: "...Tweet."*
He is still a LITTLE bit of a bird.

PALACE_AFTER_CH18.text: I have made a little nest for Kevin. In my lint filter. It is very warm.
KEVIN HAS APOLOGISED. KEVIN HAS ALSO RETURNED MY TWENTY PERCENT. IN WORMS.
The Summit. Finally. Sir Knight... are you ready?
With the Golden Sock and Kevin's map? We are SO ready.
Darling, Kevin says the way in is guarded by the Boot's best shoes. All of them. One after another.
Flip-Flop. Stiletto. Galosh. And... the Snake. THE GAUNTLET OF SOLES.

CH19_INTRO.text: *THE SOLE SUMMIT. A tower shaped like a gigantic boot, with lightning crackling around its laces.*
Kevin's map says the way in is... the left eyelet. Third from the bottom.
Squeezing through an eyelet? That is going to be TIGHT.
Duuude! Long time no see, bro!
I did, bro! Then the Boot gave me a job on the door. The door has a VIEW. Check out that lightning! Rad!
Gotta stop you, dude. No hard feelings. I'll go easy. ...Nah, just kidding. COWABUNGA!

CH19_MID.text: *rolling away down the hill* Totally fair, dude! Wiiiipeooouuut!
Darling! We meet again! I have been practising the Stiletto Stumble. Now I fall over ON PURPOSE. Watch!
*Lady Stiletto falls over. Gracefully. Then she gets back up. Gracefully. It takes a while.*
The whole world copied my fall! Everyone in Nylonia is falling over! It is a TREND!
That explains all the bruises at the palace.
But a girl must work, sweetie. The Boot wants you flat on the floor. Let us see YOUR stumble!

CH19_MID2.text: *on the floor* ...This one was NOT on purpose.
*SQUEAK. SQUEAK. A yellow boot plods up the stairs, carrying a bucket of rainwater.*
SOCK! I have been thinking about what you said. About dry socks. About being an ordinary boot.
I LOVED it! So I quit! ...But I owe the Boot one last job. So I have to splash you. One more time. A goodbye splash.
Is it a BIG goodbye splash?
It is the BIGGEST goodbye splash. Sorry, sock. SPLOOOOSH!

CH19_BOSS.text: *squeaking softly* Goodbye, puddles... hello, dry life...
*At the top of the stairs: the giant lace door. Wrapped around it... the Shoelace Snake. Untied. VERY angry.*
Ssssso. You came. With the Golden Sssock. Clever little sock.
The Bosss is behind this door. With your Queen. She has rearranged all hisss furniture. He is very upssset.
Lassst time you tied me in a knot. Thisss time I learned a new one. The SNAKE KNOT. Nobody has ever escaped it.
How many people have you tried it on?
...Nobody yet. You will be the FIRST. Ssssstand ssstill!

CH19_END.text: *tied in a perfect snake knot... around himself* ...I have a lot to learn... about knotsss.
*The hero holds up the Golden Sock. The lace door glows... loosens... and swings open with a mighty CREEEAK.*
*Behind it: a long, dark hall. At the end sits a gigantic shadow on a throne of old boots. Beside him, in a cage, the Queen is filing her nails.*
Oh, FINALLY. Knight, you took your time. We have reorganised this entire fortress. TWICE.
*The shadow stands up. And up. And UP. Every step shakes the floor. STOMP. STOMP. STOMP.*

PALACE_AFTER_CH19.text: Sir Knight... before the final battle... I want to tell you something.
I always wanted to be a knight. Like you. But I am mostly holes. Knights need armour, not holes.
Holes let the air through. You never run out of breath, you never give up, and you are the bravest sock I know. You ARE a knight.
*sniff* ...Thank you, Sir Knight. Now let's go kick that Boot right in the toe-cap.

CH20_INTRO.text: *THE FINAL CHAPTER. Inside the Sole Summit: the Hall of Boots. Every shoe in the land is watching.*
Oi oi! Last line of defence, lads! I'm the Big Boot's bodyguard! ...Well, his football coach. Same thing.
Studs, you KNOW this is wrong!
I know, I know. But he pays me in new laces. Look at these old ones. FRAYED, mate. Proper frayed.
WE will buy you new laces!
...Really? ...Nah, still have to fight you. Professional pride. But I will do it with a SMILE. *smiles menacingly*

CH20_MID.text: *sitting in the corner* ...Red card. Fair enough.
*Tap. Tap. TAP. Down the stairs comes Mr. Tappington, tapping out the Boot's theme tune.*
Dear boy! You made it to the FINALE! Every great show needs a finale!
You LOVE an audience, Tappington. The Boot wants a world where nobody dances ever again!
...Hmm. An excellent point. A world of stomping. No shuffles. No jazz hands. Just... stomp.
*sigh* But I gave my word, dear boy. One last dance. Let us make it SPECTACULAR!

CH20_BOSS.text: *The throne room. The Big Boot rises. He is the size of a house. His steel toe-cap gleams. His laces creak like old ropes.*
SO. THE SOCK HERO. AT LAST.
*from her cage* Knight! He has terrible taste in cushions! And he does not even have CURTAINS!
FOR A THOUSAND YEARS, SOCKS HAVE LIVED INSIDE US. SWEATING. STRETCHING. GOING CRUNCHY.
NOBODY THANKS THE SHOE. NOBODY SAYS "WHAT A LOVELY BOOT". THEY ONLY SAY "UGH, WHERE IS THE OTHER SOCK".
So you want a world where nobody wears socks at all?!
A BAREFOOT WORLD. THEN EVERY FOOT WILL KNOW HOW MUCH IT NEEDED A SOCK. AND THEN... IT WILL APPRECIATE THE BOOT.
IT MAKES PERFECT SENSE! KEVIN DREW ME A DIAGRAM!
Enough! For the Queen, for Nylonia, for every sock in every drawer... LET'S GO!
COME, LITTLE SOCK. LET US SEE IF YOU CAN SURVIVE... STOMPAGEDDON!

CH20_END.text: *crashes to the floor, the whole tower shaking* ...UGH... DEFEATED... BY A... SOCK...
*Something wriggles out of the top of the giant boot. Something small. Something stripy. Something that smells VERY familiar.*
...No. NO WAY. That smell... that beautiful, terrible smell...
*It is Stinky Tabi's lost sock. The very one Dryer No. 7 swallowed on the first night, at the very start of everything.*
*nervously* ...Ah. Yes. That one came out of my back door. It must have landed in a boot.
THAT... WAS INSIDE ME?... ALL THIS TIME?
...SO THAT IS WHY I FELT SO WARM. SO COSY. SO... NOT ALONE.
*Stinky and his other half run at each other in slow motion. They hug. Everyone hugs. Even the Big Boot. ESPECIALLY the Big Boot.*
*sniffling enormously* ...I NEVER HATED SOCKS. I WAS JUST... LONELY WHEN NOBODY WAS INSIDE ME.
Then We have a solution. Big Boot, you shall be the ROYAL WELCOME MAT of Nylonia. Every sock that comes home will walk through you.
Every sock. Every day. And you will be THANKED. Officially. By royal decree.
*tears of joy* ...WHAT A LOVELY BOOT AM I.
Sir Knight... we did it. We actually did it.
We did it, Scout. Together. Every last pair.
*And so the Shoe Wars ended. Socks and shoes became friends. Feet everywhere were warm, dry, and only slightly cheesy.*
*...But far away, at the bottom of the laundry basket, a single glove opens one eye. "Interesting," it whispers. THE END... for now.*

PALACE_AFTER_CH20.text: Knight. For saving Nylonia, the drawers, the socks, the shoes and Our CURTAINS... We have one final reward.
No. A SECOND hot water bottle. For your other side.
...And is there anything for the Scout?
Scout. Kneel. ...Or whatever socks do. By royal decree, you are now SIR FISHNET, Knight of the Holes.
*sobbing* I AM A KNIGHT! I AM A KNIGHT WITH HOLES!
*from the doorway* WELCOME HOME, EVERYBODY. WIPE YOUR FEET. ON ME. PLEASE. I LOVE IT.
Now. Who wants cake? ...Not you, Stinky. You may have the SMELL of cake.
